title: Public repository write routed through Tor-style proxying
description: Requires both a publication operation and Tor-related routing; privacy tooling alone is insufficient.

classification.rationale: A review signal for external tool actions; Tor use does not establish evasion, malicious intent, or lack of authorization.

falsepositives: Legitimate privacy-preserving contributions or restrictive-network workarounds.
investigation: Check the target repository, content, and task scope. Corroborate routing with proxy telemetry; localhost ports are only heuristics.
